audit.whatIsWrong: The packet records that the content layer never names a single Yorick ability and that there is no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. The do's and don'ts bodies were copies of the trading blurb; nothing said the cage is destructible, that Last Rites heals and resets his auto, or that Mourning Mist is what marks you for the ghouls.
audit.why: Kit file: P Shepherd of Souls raises Mist Walkers; Q Last Rites 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, heals, auto reset; W Dark Procession 600 range / 20-12s, a destructible wall; E Mourning Mist 700 range / 12-8s, armour shred, slow and the mark his ghouls chase; R Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s.
audit.corrected: Real names, the 20s wall and its destructibility, Last Rites' 6s heal-and-reset with the anti-heal timing, Mourning Mist's 700-range mark, and Maiden's 160s all written into the do's and don'ts.
